hints: Since $\angle ABC = 90^\circ$, the perpendicular gradient of $BC$ is $m_{BC} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$.
walkthrough:
The right angle fixes one gradient from the other.
Calculate gradient $m_{AB}$ and find the perpendicular gradient $m_{BC}$:
$$m_{AB} = \dfrac{6 - 0}{3 - 0} = 2$$
$$m_{BC} = -\dfrac{1}{m_{AB}} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$$

Set up the gradient formula for $BC$ and solve for $k$:
$$m_{BC} = \dfrac{0 - 6}{k - 3} = -\dfrac{1}{2}$$
$$\dfrac{-6}{k - 3} = -\dfrac{1}{2} \implies k - 3 = 12 \implies k = 15$$
